title: Welcome Lens: compact onboarding tour + checklist assets for Console
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver a compact, dismissible onboarding panel ("Welcome Lens") that surfaces a 4-step checklist, contextual tips, and empty-state illustrations for Console's first-run experience. The Welcome Lens should be non-modal, keyboard-accessible, and able to be pinned/unpinned by the user. Deliverables: Figma components, Lottie animation spec for micro-interactions, production-ready SVGs for empty states (3 variants), microcopy bank for tips, and a handoff pack with CSS tokens and accessibility notes.
acceptance_criteria: Welcome Lens component design completed in Figma with single-instance and pinned states
4 checklist steps with completion states, check animations defined (Lottie JSON spec), and keyboard focus order documented
Empty-state SVGs (no-projects, no-routes, no-evals) exported in 2 color modes (light/dark) and checked against console color tokens
Microcopy bank includes 12 tip variations (short, medium, long) and localized guidance for en-US & en-GB
Handoff package includes usage notes, CSS variable names, and a 1-page accessibility checklist (ARIA roles, contrast, focus management)
Design reviewed and approved by PM & Accessibility reviewer, and assets uploaded to the shared Figma and Drive links below
progress_updates: 2025-08-13: Initial wireframes completed — focused on a compact top-left panel to avoid modal interruptions. Shared with PM for scope alignment.
2025-08-19: Micro-interaction explorations (shrink/expand + check animation) prototyped in Principle. Confirmed 200ms check timing with dev for perceived snappiness.
2025-08-26: Accessibility review requested — Jakob Nielsen checklist applied, flagged focus trap risk when Lens is pinned; updated nav order to prevent trap.
2025-09-01: Engineering feasibility sync — agreed to provide a CSS token mapping and a light/dark SVG export set. ENG indicated Lottie support requires fallback to CSS animation for older browsers.
2025-09-02: First dev handoff delivered to Drive and Figma; awaiting review from PM (Riley Morgan) and Accessibility (Sofia Alvarez).
review_feedback: PM Riley Morgan (2025-08-20): Prefer a 3-step progressive disclosure on initial run to reduce cognitive load; suggested rewording step 2 to be action-oriented.
Eng Lead Noah Park (2025-08-27): Lottie is fine but please produce a CSS keyframe fallback; note token names for colors to ensure correct theming.
Accessibility Sofia Alvarez (2025-08-28): Add ARIA-labelledby for the Lens container, ensure 'Close' and 'Pin' buttons are reachable via screen reader, and test with voiceover and NVDA.
design_decisions: Use a compact, non-modal panel anchored to the top-left to minimize context switching and preserve console workflow
Provide both pinned and transient states: transient auto-collapses after 8 seconds of inactivity, pinned remains until user unpins
Three empty-state illustration variants instead of one, to reduce repeat content and increase perceived relevance
Microcopy tone: short, action-first; CTAs use verbs (e.g., 'Create route', 'Import model') to improve conversion
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Panel could interfere with small-screen layouts — Mitigation: auto-hide on widths < 880px and surface an inline inline-tip instead
Risk: Lottie not supported everywhere — Mitigation: provide CSS fallback and static SVG frame for legacy browsers
Risk: Overlap with existing welcome experiments — Mitigation: coordinate with PM-4021 to retire prior experiment before launch
next_steps: Finalize copy variants and prepare localization file (i18n keys) — due 2025-09-04
Work with ENG to validate CSS token names and export assets in production-ready directories — due 2025-09-06
Conduct 3 quick accessibility checks with NVDA, VoiceOver, and keyboard-only flow — due 2025-09-07
Create a short demo video (30s) of the Welcome Lens in both pinned and transient flows for the release notes — due 2025-09-09
notes_for_engineering: Provide CSS variables for --welcome-lens-bg, --welcome-lens-border, and --welcome-lens-foreground. See handoff PDF for suggested values.
Lottie JSON should expose a single 'check' animation segment (0-24 frames) with a 200ms duration target — fallback: SVG with CSS stroke-dasharray animation.
Panel open/close and pin/unpin events must emit analytics events: onboarding.lens.open, onboarding.lens.pin, onboarding.lens.complete_step
Ensure panel does not create a keyboard focus trap when pinned: focus should move to next app shell item after tabbing out
